battle.name: 廓藏戰爭
battle.brief: 一八五五年三月，廓爾喀首相江格·巴哈杜爾·拉納以使團受辱、新瓦里商人被徵收與克蒂邊界爭端為由向西藏宣戰，四月初分三路越過山口，投入二萬七千人、三十六門砲與八門迫擊砲。卡面這門一八五〇年的德意志線膛野戰砲象徵射程革命，但遠征帶山的仍是前裝滑膛砲；扭轉戰局者是章卡攻堅九天與雪季反攻。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 打的是廓爾喀王國與清朝藩部西藏，兩邊都不是對等的國家。尼泊爾一方的統治核心在加德滿都拉納家族手上：一八四六年江格·巴哈杜爾·拉納以政變奪權，此後以世襲首相兼陸軍總司令的身份號令全國，國王只剩下象徵性的印璽。遠征軍按四路軸線編制，各軸主將多出自家親族：克榮軸主將巴姆·巴哈杜爾·庫瓦，率兵二萬五千七百二十八人；克蒂軸主將迪爾·順謝爾·拉納，率兵四千六百七十八人；霍姆拉與馬斯塘一路由克里希那·多吉·庫瓦率二千五百人；俄朗仲古拉一路由普里特維·多吉·庫瓦上校率二千人。軍令自加德滿都發出，後方由各地土官與村社分擔糧秣與徵發，武器則多經英屬印度購置。西藏一方是拉薩的甘丹頗章政府，名義上受清朝保護，實權分散在達賴喇嘛衙門與噶廈的數名噶倫手中：噶倫策墊奪吉在前線，噶倫夏扎·旺曲杰布與策林第巴等僧俗官員分掌後方，藏軍總指揮是色提亞·卡吉，約五萬人分佈於定日一線與迪加爾查前線，關隘、渡口與寺院城堡各由營官率僧俗土兵分守。清廷是背後的第三方而非交戰主力：咸豐朝設駐藏大臣赫特賀與幫辦大臣滿慶駐節拉薩，掌對外交涉與調兵之權，但朝廷正全力應付太平天國與捻軍，兵餉兩缺，遲至一八五五年底才准自內地調二千清兵入藏；四川方面也因西陽、秀山、越巂一帶正在用兵而無力分撥。英屬印度既未參戰亦未干涉，只由駐尼泊爾公使在往來文書中記下雙方的開支與損失。
countriesEn: What fought here was the Kingdom of Nepal against Tibet under Qing protection, two authorities rather than two equal sovereign states. On the Nepali side the effective government sat in Kathmandu in the hands of the Rana family: in 1846 Jung Bahadur Rana (江格·巴哈杜爾·拉納) seized power and thereafter ruled as hereditary prime minister and commander-in-chief, while the king kept only a symbolic seal. The invading force was organised into four axes, each under a general taken from the Rana family and its allies: the Kerong axis under Bam Bahadur Kunwar with 25,728 men, the Kuti axis under Dhir Shumsher Rana with 4,678, the Humla and Mustang line under Krishna Dhoj Kunwar with 2,500, and the Olangchunggola axis under Colonel Prithvi Dhoj Kunwar with 2,000. Orders travelled out from Kathmandu, while the districts and village communities behind the front carried the burden of requisition and supply, and most of the weapons were bought through British India. The Tibetan side was the Ganden Phodrang government of Lhasa, nominally under Qing protection but with real authority divided between the Dalai Lama's office and several Kashag ministers: the Kashag minister Ceten (策墊) handled the front, Shasza Wangchuk (夏扎·旺曲杰布) and the Kharpa held the rear, and Sethya Kaji (色提亞·卡吉) commanded the Tibetan army, some 50,000 strong, spread over the Tingri line and the Digarcha front, every pass, ford and monastery fort being held by monks and lay soldiers under its own camp commandant. The Qing court was the third party behind the fighting rather than a main belligerent: the amban Hetehe (赫特賀) and the assistant resident Manqing (滿慶) sat at Lhasa with authority over foreign relations and the movement of troops, but the Xianfeng court was absorbed by the Taiping and Nian rebellions and was short of men and money, and only at the end of 1855 did it approve the despatch of 2,000 imperial troops into Tibet, while Sichuan, busy at Xiyang, Xiushan and Yuexi, could spare nobody either. British India fought in neither campaign and intervened in neither, its minister at Kathmandu merely recording the costs and losses of both sides in his correspondence.
people: 拉納家族的江格·巴哈杜爾·拉納是這場戰爭的推手。他一八五一年曾率團遊歐，見過歐洲的槍砲與財政制度；上位後在加德滿都掌握實權，卻面對國內反對派與空虛的國庫，於是把一八五五年三月當成出手的時機。他以一八五二年使團在拉薩受輕慢、新瓦里商人被徵收與傷害、克蒂一帶邊界爭端為由下最後通牒，限期四月十七日答覆割地賠款，並自任全軍統帥。他的弟弟迪爾·順謝爾·拉納任克蒂軸主將，四月初一度奇襲克蒂得手，十一月初五夜襲中損失約七百人，十二月靠增援收復克蒂，焚城而退回合境利提。巴姆·巴哈杜爾·庫瓦統率的克榮軸人數最多，不戰而取克榮，推進至庫庫爾山口，再在章卡與藏軍攻守九天。霍姆拉與馬斯塘一路的克里希那·多吉·庫瓦、俄朗仲古拉一路的普里特維·多吉·庫瓦上校各守一翼，另有薩納克·辛格·卡德利上校於十二月解章卡之圍。藏方以色提亞·卡吉統五萬之眾而不能集兵，冬季反攻的實際策劃者是卡隆·沙拉；前線的策墊奪吉因分兵攻絨轄而致聶拉木復失，被清廷以「貪功妄舉」革職，責令戴罪自贖。清朝方面，駐藏大臣赫特賀往返文書、與四川的樂斌、黃宗漢等籌議控制廓夷六條，幫辦大臣滿慶奉命統帶入藏清兵與前藏僧俗土兵。此時剛成年的第十一世達賴喇嘛凱珠嘉措暴病而亡，攝政哷徵呼圖克圖與噶廈的關係又不融洽，藏方在談判桌上缺少可以一言九鼎的人。
peopleEn: Jung Bahadur Rana (江格·巴哈杜爾·拉納) was the man who set this war in motion. In 1851 he led a mission to Europe and saw European guns and finance for himself; once he had power in Kathmandu he still faced opposition at home and an empty treasury, and so chose March 1855 as the moment to strike. His pretexts were the ill-treatment of the 1852 embassy at Lhasa, the taxing and rough handling of Newar traders, and the boundary quarrel around Kuti; he set 17 April as the deadline for an answer granting cession and compensation, and reserved the supreme command to himself. His brother Dhir Shumsher Rana led the Kuti axis, snapped up Kuti by surprise in early April, lost about 700 men when his camp was attacked on 5 November, and in December retook the place with reinforcements, burned it and withdrew to Listi inside Nepalese territory. Bam Bahadur Kunwar, commanding the Kerong axis with the largest body of men, took Kerong without a fight, pushed on through the Kukurghat pass and fought the Tibetans for nine days at Dzongka. Krishna Dhoj Kunwar held the Humla and Mustang line, Colonel Prithvi Dhoj Kunwar the Olangchunggola axis, and Colonel Sanak Singh Khatri (薩納克·辛格·卡德利) relieved Dzongka in December. On the Tibetan side Sethya Kaji (色提亞·卡吉) nominally commanded 50,000 men without being able to concentrate them, and the real planner of the winter counter-offensive was Kalon Shatra (卡隆·沙拉); the Kashag minister Ceten (策墊) lost Nyalam after splitting his force to attack Rongxiang, and was dismissed by the Qing court for reckless self-seeking, with orders to redeem himself in the field. On the Qing side the amban Hetehe (赫特賀) handled the correspondence and worked out with the Sichuan authorities Le Bin (樂斌) and Huang Zonghan (黃宗漢) the six measures for controlling the Gurkhas, while the assistant resident Manqing (滿慶) was charged with escorting the imperial reinforcements and the monks and soldiers drawn from front Tibet. At that moment the newly adult eleventh Dalai Lama Khedrup Gyatso (凱珠嘉措) died suddenly of illness, and the regent Shesreng (哷徵呼圖克圖) had never been strong, so the Tibetan side had nobody at the negotiating table who could speak with a single voice.
kits: 卡面這門一八五〇年的德意志線膛野戰砲在這條戰線上沒有出現過。線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠，是十九世紀中葉普魯士砲兵正在推開的變革；一八五五年的尼泊爾遠征軍帶上喜馬拉雅山口的仍是前裝滑膛砲，共三十六門，另有八門迫擊砲，多屬銅身短管、口徑不大、射程有限的老式野戰砲，拆卸後以騡牛分載翻越山口，展開一次便要半日，攻蘇納寺、章卡這類寺院城堡時多只能封住缺口、壓制城頭，不能擊毀牆基。藏軍裝備更舊：步兵是火繩槍配長刀，關隘與寺院用少量清廷頒發或本地鑄造的銅砲，後方近拉薩一線火力稍強，卻運不上高山，一旦冬季封路即成廢鐵。清廷援兵攜中式火炮與冷兵器到達邊地，但本身不熟悉山道作戰。尼泊爾步兵用燧發滑膛步槍配刺刀，火藥與彈藥靠騡馬與背夫翻越山口轉運，糧秣由加德滿都經熱拉、克蒂一線接力；冬天的暴雪讓火繩難以點燃、凍住的槍機難以擊發，火力在幾天之內可以等於零。由此看，決定這場戰爭的不是那三十八門火器，而是山口、糧秣與季節。
kitsEn: The field gun of 1850 shown on the card never appeared on this front. Rifling, which lets the same charge of gunpowder carry further, was the revolution Prussian gunners were pushing in the middle of the nineteenth century; what the Nepali expedition carried over the Himalayan passes in 1855 was still the smoothbore muzzle-loading gun, thirty-six of them, with eight mortars, mostly short-barrelled bronze pieces of small calibre and limited range. They were broken down and carried in pieces on mules, and half a day was needed to bring one into action; against monastery fortresses such as Suna Gompa and Dzongka they could usually only seal a breach and keep the defenders off the parapet, not smash the wall foundations. The Tibetan equipment was older still: matchlock muskets with long knives in the infantry, a few cast or Qing-issue bronze guns at the passes and monasteries, and slightly heavier fire near Lhasa behind them, but none of it could be carried up the high passes, where a closed winter road turned every gun into scrap. The Qing reinforcements brought Chinese-pattern cannon and cold weapons to the frontier, though their troops were unused to fighting in the mountains. The Nepali infantry carried flintlock smoothbore muskets with bayonets, and powder, shot and baggage had to be moved by mule and human porter over the passes, with grain coming on from Kathmandu through Jara and the Kuti line; in the blizzards of the winter season a matchlock could hardly be lit and a frozen lock would not fire, so the firepower of a whole position could be worth nothing for days. The guns therefore were not what decided this war. The passes, the supply line and the season were.
tactics: 這場高山戰爭的節奏完全由山口、寺院堡壘與雪季決定。一八五五年四月初，遠征軍同時越過瓦隆仲至熱拉一線的多個山口，人數最多的克榮軸沿克榮溝北進，先取克榮，再取庫庫爾山口，最後在章卡與藏軍對攻九天，藏軍退守定日才收兵；克蒂軸以奇襲取克蒂、逼退蘇納寺守軍，戰果雖大，卻沒有解決章卡一線的正面堡壘。十月藏軍一度收復聶拉木，尼泊爾派兵增援再奪回。五月至九月，雙方在什卡爾仲一帶談判僵持，尼泊爾沒有力氣再打一次攻勢，藏方卻有自己的算盤：十一月初五，卡隆·沙拉指揮藏軍以兩支隊伍同時夜襲克蒂與章卡的尼泊爾營地，卡在雪季封山這個時機上，尼泊爾軍在克蒂損失約七百人，倖存者退回邊境，章卡的守軍反被包圍；十二月迪爾·順謝爾靠增援多面夾擊收復克蒂，焚城後退回利提，章卡之圍由薩納克·辛格·卡德利上校解開。清廷的處置則是剿撫兼施：諭令前藏挑備僧俗土兵二千赴通拉山策墊軍營，糧秣由滿慶籌備，並以江孜與定日汛馬布加為中道要害添防；同時以檄諭、羈縻為質、歸還所斷唐古忒稅銀等手段分化對方。多路分進、以寺廟與渡口設防、避免冬季主動出擊，是雙方共同的經驗。
tacticsEn: The rhythm of this mountain war was set entirely by the passes, the monastery fortresses and the winter season. In early April 1855 the expedition crossed several passes on the line from Walungchung to Jara at the same time. The largest force, the Kerong axis, pushed north up the Kerong valley, took Kerong, then Kukurghat, and finally fought the Tibetans for nine days at Dzongka, and only when the Tibetans fell back on Tingri did the advance stop; the Kuti axis snapped up Kuti by surprise and drove off the garrison of Suna Gompa, a success that did not solve the frontal fortress line at Dzongka. In October the Tibetans recovered Nyalam for a time, and Nepali reinforcements retook it. The talks at Shikarjong dragged on from May to September without settlement; Nepal could not mount another offensive because its treasury was empty, while the Tibetans had their own calculation to make. On 5 November the Tibetan force under Kalon Shatra (卡隆·沙拉) struck the Nepali camps at Kuti and Dzongka simultaneously with two columns, choosing the moment when the snow was closing the passes: the Nepalis lost about 700 men at Kuti and the survivors fell back to the border, while the Dzongka garrison was invested in turn. In December Dhir Shumsher retook Kuti with reinforcements and a pincer movement, burned the place and withdrew to Listi, and the siege of Dzongka was relieved by Colonel Sanak Singh Khatri. The Qing response combined pursuit with conciliation: the court ordered 2,000 monks and soldiers picked from front Tibet to the camp of Ceten at Tongla, with rations and ammunition to be prepared by Manqing, and added men at Gyantse and at Mabuka, the Tingri garrison, both of them key points on the road; at the same time proclamations, hostages kept at court and the return of the Tibetans' tax silver were used to divide the enemy. Multi-axis advance, defence anchored on monasteries and fords, and reluctance to attack in winter were lessons both sides drew from it.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。尼泊爾遠征軍四軸合計約三萬四千九百零六人：克榮軸二萬五千七百二十八人、克蒂軸四千六百七十八人、霍姆拉與馬斯塘二千五百人、俄朗仲古拉一軸二千人；最初投入作戰者約二萬七千人，攜三十六門砲與八門迫擊砲。藏軍總數約五萬人，其中定日一線四萬人、迪加爾查前線八千人，蘇納寺一處即有守軍八千人；清方文書則記前藏挑備僧俗土兵二千名待調。清廷直到一八五五年底才令幫辦大臣滿慶調二千清兵入藏。時間線：江格·巴哈杜爾·拉納於一八五五年三月下最後通牒，限期四月十七日，遠征於四月初開始，五月至九月談判未果，十一月初五藏軍發動冬季反攻，十二月尼泊爾軍收復克蒂，一八五六年一月西藏代表與清使抵加德滿都，三月廿四日於塔帕塔利簽約。錢的數目最關鍵：尼泊爾原索賠一千萬盧比，最後降為每年一萬盧比，首期一次付清五萬零一盧比。傷亡方面，十一月初五克蒂之戰尼方損失約七百人，藏方損失數字不詳。各家記錄互有出入，引用時應保留這些出入。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. The four Nepali axes came to about 34,906 men in all: 25,728 on the Kerong axis, 4,678 on the Kuti axis, 2,500 on the Humla and Mustang line and 2,000 on the Olangchunggola axis; the force actually committed at the opening was about 27,000, with thirty-six guns and eight mortars. The Tibetan army numbered about 50,000, of whom 40,000 were on the Tingri line and 8,000 on the Digarcha front, with 8,000 holding Suna Gompa alone; the Chinese records speak of 2,000 monks and soldiers picked from front Tibet and awaiting orders. Not until the end of 1855 did the court order Manqing to bring 2,000 imperial troops into Tibet. The timeline: Jung Bahadur Rana delivered his ultimatum in March 1855 with 17 April as the deadline, the invasion opened in early April, the talks of May to September broke down, the Tibetans counter-attacked on 5 November, the Nepalis retook Kuti in December, a Tibetan delegation with a Chinese envoy reached Kathmandu in January 1856, and the treaty was signed at Thapathali on 24 March. Money mattered most of all: the original Nepali claim of ten million rupees was cut to ten thousand rupees a year, and the first payment was made in one sum of 50,001 rupees. On casualties, the fighting at Kuti on 5 November cost the Nepalis about 700 men, while the Tibetan losses are not recorded. The sources disagree on many of these figures, and the disagreements should be kept rather than smoothed away.
cause: 動因有三層。最表層是幾樁被拿來當藉口的事：一八五二年尼泊爾遣使赴拉薩，回程與在藏期間的待遇被指為受輕慢；拉薩對尼泊爾新瓦里商人的徵收與刁難被列為罪狀；克蒂一帶的邊界與草場歸屬爭議被說成是藏方越界。這三件事本身並不致命，卻被拿去包裝一次以割地賠款為目的的進攻。第二層是尼泊爾自身的政治需要：拉納家族一八四六年掌權後正要把廓爾喀的國家機器重新握緊，一八五一年遊歐之後又對近代火砲與財政有了新的指望；一八五四年尼泊爾曾提議派兵協助清廷剿滅太平天國、由西藏地方負擔軍費，未獲應允，此後便把怨氣轉向拉薩。軍功與新得的邊境地盤可以安撫國內反對者，也可以向英屬印度與清朝證明尼泊爾並非只能服從。第三層是國際條件：太平天國與捻軍把清朝的兵與財拖在內地，英屬印度在克里米亞戰爭中與俄國交鋒、無力介入喜馬拉雅，章巴因此判定越過喜馬拉雅不致招來有效干涉。西藏方面也有自己的算盤：清廷鞭長莫及，藏軍人多而山路熟；一八四六年琦善所訂《裁禁商上積弊章程》已裁撤藏軍操演，僧官與噶廈不睦，攝政哷徵呼圖克圖無力，六世班禪於一八五二年去世、十一世達賴年幼，決策與指揮都難以統一。
causeEn: There were three layers of motive. On the surface lay a set of grievances used as pretexts: the reception given to the Nepalese mission of 1852 at Lhasa, and its return journey, were said to have been humiliating; the levying of dues and the rough treatment of Newar traders in Lhasa were put on the list of wrongs; and a quarrel over the boundary and the grazing lands around Kuti was presented as a Tibetan encroachment. None of the three was fatal in itself, yet they were used to dress up an invasion aimed at territorial cession and compensation. The second layer was Nepali political necessity: the Rana family, in power since 1846, was tightening its grip on the state machine of the kingdom, and the tour of Europe in 1851 had given Jung Bahadur new ideas about modern artillery and public finance. In 1854 Nepal had offered troops to help the Qing destroy the Taiping, with the costs to be borne by Tibet, and been refused; the grievance was then turned on Lhasa instead. Military laurels and new border territory would quiet the opposition at home and show British India and the Qing court that Nepal was not a state to be ordered about. The third layer was the international situation: the Taiping and Nian rebellions tied down the Qing armies and treasury, and British India was locked in the Crimean War against Russia with no reach into the Himalaya, so Jung Bahadur judged that crossing the Himalaya would bring no effective interference. Tibet had its own calculation: the Qing were too far away to help, the Tibetan army was numerous and knew the paths, and since 1846 the regulations on abolishing the abuses of the Shangshang drawn up by Qishan (琦善) had curtailed the training of the Tibetan troops, while the regent Shesreng was weak, the Sixth Panchen Lama had died in 1852 and the eleventh Dalai Lama was a boy, so that decisions and command could not be unified.
impact: 後果分四層。對尼泊爾，短期是財政重創：國庫被進軍與佔領吃空，反戰聲浪在國內上升，遠征軍既無士氣也無補給再打一個攻勢，江格·巴哈杜爾·拉納不得不把索賠砍到象徵性的年度一萬盧比，並放棄一切領土要求。對西藏，邊界第一次以條約形式固定下來，尼泊爾歸還所占的龍、尼亞木、章卡、布朗、榮竹一帶土地，並歸還俘虜與被奪的砲位；但代價是每年向尼泊爾付出一萬盧比，容許尼泊爾在拉薩設商站與常駐官員，尼泊爾商人還免徵商稅與路稅，這在西藏的財政與主權觀念上都是新的讓步，而第二年拒付餘款又讓糾紛延續。對清朝，咸豐朝被迫在太平天國之外再操心西南邊疆，被迫自內地調兵，而調兵本身暴露了邊防的虛弱，此後清廷對藏邊的經營更倚賴駐藏大臣與地方僧官的配合，也留下剿撫兼施的處置成例。對南亞與英屬印度，尼泊爾在對清交涉中換來實惠，地位上升，一八五七年印度起義時更出兵助英平亂，英國對尼泊爾的態度因此改變，到一九二三年才以條約正式承認其獨立主權。
impactEn: The consequences fall into four layers. For Nepal it was a short-term fiscal catastrophe: the treasury was emptied by the march and the occupation, opposition to the war rose at home, the expedition had neither morale nor supplies for another offensive, and Jung Bahadur had to cut his claim to the token annual payment of ten thousand rupees and abandon all territorial demands. For Tibet the frontier was fixed for the first time by treaty: Nepal returned the lands it had taken around Long, Nyalam, Dzongka, Blang and Rongju and gave back prisoners and captured gun positions; the price was an annual payment of 10,000 rupees, the right for a Nepalese trading station and a resident official at Lhasa, and exemption for Nepali merchants from commercial and road dues, all of them new concessions in Tibetan fiscal and sovereign terms, while the refusal to pay the second year's instalment kept the quarrel alive. For the Qing court, the Xianfeng administration had to worry about the south-western frontier on top of the Taiping, had to move troops inland to Tibet, and in doing so exposed how thin the border defence was; thereafter it leaned harder on the amban working with the local monastic authorities, and the handling of this affair left a precedent of pursuing the enemy and courting him at the same time. For South Asia and British India, Nepal had gained real advantages in its dealings with the Qing and rose in standing; it sent troops to help the British put down the Indian Rebellion of 1857, which changed London's attitude, and it was not until 1923 that a treaty formally recognised Nepal's independent sovereignty.
result: 結果是雙方都沒拿到想要的東西。一八五五年四月的夏季攻勢，尼泊爾越過多個山口，奪取克蒂與克榮，在章卡攻堅九天逼退藏軍至定日，看似順利；五月至九月的談判卻在什卡爾仲一帶一再破裂，尼泊爾索賠一千萬盧比與割地的要求始終無法落實。十一月初五的冬季反攻才是戰局轉折：藏軍卡隆·沙拉以雪季為掩護，同時夜襲克蒂與章卡，尼泊爾軍在克蒂損失約七百人，倖存者退回邊境；十二月迪爾·順謝爾收復克蒂、焚城退回利提，章卡之圍由薩納克·辛格·卡德利上校解開，雙方回到出發前的分界線附近。一八五六年三月廿四日，條約在加德滿都近郊的塔帕塔利簽訂，共十條：藏方每年付一萬盧比並一次性先付五萬零一盧比，允許尼泊爾在拉薩設商站與代表機構，歸還土地、俘虜與砲位，尼泊爾則放棄割地要求，雙方並互相尊重清帝。從兵器看，這是一場前裝滑膛砲與火繩槍在高海拔山口的較量；卡面那門一八五〇年的線膛野戰砲所象徵的射程革命，要到線膛真正壓倒滑膛之後才會出現在這一帶的山口上。
resultEn: In the end neither side got what it wanted. The summer offensive of April 1855 looked successful: the Nepalis crossed several passes, took Kuti and Kerong, and after nine days of siege at Dzongka drove the Tibetans back to Tingri. But the talks of May to September broke down again and again at Shikarjong, and the demands for ten million rupees and for cession of territory were never met. The winter counter-offensive of 5 November was the real turning point: under cover of the season Kalon Shatra struck Kuti and Dzongka at the same time, the Nepalis lost about 700 men at Kuti and the survivors fell back to the border, and in December Dhir Shumsher retook Kuti, burned it and withdrew to Listi while the siege of Dzongka was relieved by Colonel Sanak Singh Khatri, leaving both armies close to the line from which they had started. On 24 March 1856 the treaty was signed at Thapathali, near Kathmandu, in ten articles: Tibet would pay ten thousand rupees a year and fifty thousand and one rupees in a single first payment, would allow a Nepalese trading station and agency at Lhasa, and would return the lands, prisoners and captured guns, while Nepal abandoned its territorial claims and both sides pledged respect for the Qing emperor. In terms of weapons this was a contest between smoothbore muzzle-loading guns and matchlocks fought in high passes; the range revolution that the field gun of 1850 on the card stands for would only reach these passes once rifling had genuinely beaten smoothbores.
